## REQ-CMP-008

**Resource interaction patterns via the Method element**

From Level 2 on, a component supports the resource interaction patterns of the Method element: requesting resources via Get, modifying resources via Set and Del where applicable, and publishing resources via Pub (MG 7.1.4, MG 9.1). The methods per entity type are detailed by REQ-CMP-014 to REQ-CMP-016, REQ-CMP-033 and REQ-CMP-034.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 none · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Scope: MG 7.1.4, MG 9.1
- Refs: MG 1.3, MG 7.2
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-1.3-24be5cc5

> Resource interaction patterns via the Method element: requesting resources via Get, modifying resources via Set and Del (where applicable) and publishing resources via Pub (7.1.4 Method Element, 9.1 Resources) - Mandatory Mandatory
> — MG 1.3

## REQ-CMP-010

**Complete Message Bus behavior**

At Level 3, a component supports all methods, resources and common services required for its entity type (REQ-CMP-014 to REQ-CMP-021, REQ-CMP-033 to REQ-CMP-040), each with all methods MG 9 defines for it and conforming completely to MG 9, also for resources for which it has no content (REQ-CMP-041 to REQ-CMP-043). At Level 2, this is recommended beyond the Level 2 minimum set.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 none · L2 SHOULD · L3 MUST

- Refs: MG 1.3, MG 7.2, SF-037
- Verification: d7-test, d7-monitor
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-1.3-0745092e, MG-1.3-2f5f05fb, MG-7.2-9e0478b4

> Complete Message Bus behavior: all methods, resources and common services, i.e. in addition the methods Set and Del for all resources for which they are defined, the methods Call and Reply, the resources Config, Data, Metadata, Event, Profile, PublicationList, SubscriptionList and ReferenceDesignation and the common service NewDataSetWriterId, also if the component has no content for a resource (7.2 Minimum Set of Topic Elements for Open Industry 4.0 Alliance Compliance, 9 Message Bus Communication) - Recommended Mandatory

## REQ-CMP-011

**Messaging compliance without stated level means Level 3**

A component labeled "Open Industry 4.0 Alliance Compliant" without a stated compliance level fulfills Level 3 of the OEC Messaging Compliance. D7 uses Level 3 as declared level for such a component.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component, manufacturer
- Condition: The component is labeled compliant without stating a compliance level.

- Verification: manual, d7-test
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-1.3-193fdc81

> A component that is labeled "Open Industry 4.0 Alliance Compliant" without stating a compliance level, must fulfill Level 3 in all applicable compliance domains.
> — MG 1.3

## REQ-CMP-013

**Registry may show an observed messaging compliance level**

The OEC Registry may show an observed OEC Messaging Compliance level per application and device, derived from the observed behavior (e.g. the resources listed in Profile and the answers to Get requests). The observed level is informative only and does not replace the declared and validated level.

- Keyword: MAY
- Domain: platform · Applies to: registry
- Refs: MG 1.3, MG A1
- Verification: manual
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-1.3-200baca0, MG-1.3-886a2a1d

## REQ-CMP-016

**Methods Set and Del for resources offered for modification**

From Level 2 on, an application or device supports the methods Set and Del for every resource it offers for modification by other participants on the Message Bus (e.g. Config) – "Where applicable" in the method tables. Level 1 entities are not required to support Set or Del. At Level 3, REQ-CMP-033 extends this to all resources.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 none · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The entity offers a resource for modification by other participants.
- Refs: MG 7.2, MG 7.2.1, MG 7.2.2, SF-037
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-7.2-c5492774, MG-7.2.1-9feb5375, MG-7.2.1-ab6c8f8b, MG-7.2.1-aecfb3e9, MG-7.2.2-a42b3293, MG-7.2.2-c1248a42, MG-7.2.2-e4b7c5ad

> — MG 7.2.1

A smart device that is connected directly to the Message Bus with its own MQTT client fulfills the requirements for applications (MG 7.2.1), including REQ-CMP-019, REQ-CMP-034, REQ-CMP-039 and REQ-CMP-040.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: device
- Condition: The device has its own MQTT client connected directly to the Message Bus.
- Refs: MG 7.2.2
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-7.2.2-96b56eb1

> A smart device that is connected directly to the Message Bus with its own MQTT client must fulfill the requirements of 7.2.1 For Applications.
> — MG 7.2.2

Notes: The guideline used "has to" (implicit, SF-035) until C-015; now "must".

## REQ-CMP-025

**Field presence follows the Requirement attribute**

In every payload object, a field whose attribute Requirement is Mandatory is present, and a field whose Requirement is Not used is absent. A field marked Optional may be present.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: publisher
- Refs: MG 1.2
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: draft

## REQ-CMP-044

**Get of Metadata without Data – no Metadata, optional Event Status Bad**

An entity does not answer a Get of Metadata for a Source and Filter for which it provides no Data with Metadata. It may answer such a Get with an Event of the category Status and the level Bad (BadNotFound). A requester (and D7) requests Metadata only for Data announced in the PublicationList; silence on other Metadata requests is conformant.

- Keyword: MAY
- Levels: L1 MAY · L2 MAY · L3 MAY
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The entity supports the resource Metadata and receives a Get for a Source/Filter without Data.
- Scope: MG 9.1.5, MG 8.3.6.1
- Refs: MG 7.2, SF-039
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-7.2-75e4e7b6

> The entity may answer such a Get with an Event of the category Status and the level Bad (BadNotFound).
> — MG 7.2
